'''Virdugo Plunge''' was the most prominent, and largest, waterfall in [[Theed]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Naboo]]'s [[human]] [[Naboo (people)|denizens]]. Marking the end of a tributary of the [[Solleu River]], it was located near the [[Theed Royal Palace|Royal Palace's]] [[Theed Hangar|hangar]].<ref name="SWCL" />
